review.meaning: the in/out details defect is corrected from dedicated Monday columns; every rule checked against the printed form and the live Monday schema; contradictory inputs are refused. Not approved by RSFA; not compared with a MacroForge output.
openQuestions: 3c 'Average value per deposit' (Check Box100: <$1,000 / $1,000-$10,000 / >$10,000) has no matching Monday column (the ASB cash column uses different bands): left blank for the adviser, as in the legacy configuration.
'GHL Why have you come to Sovereign Home Loans?' is multi-select on Monday but its two boxes are one checkbox field: selecting both is refused.

The board also has unused near-duplicates 'International Money Transfers – In/Out average value per payment' (no labels configured) and 'International payments activity details (including countries)'; the engine uses the GHL Trust columns and the dedicated In/Out detail columns. Confirm these are the columns advisers fill.
Expected differences from MacroForge in a parallel run: 3d/3e details (MacroForge copies one text into both), 3c details, the $1,000-$10,000 band and multi-source ticks.
